headline: Weathered Expanse Turns Warden; Nevish Line Swings Back to Colonials
war_summary: The board has shifted again since the last edition. In the Weathered Expanse, the busiest ground of the war, the Wardens have pressed forward to five works against a single Colonial holding and three unclaimed, a reversal of the even three-way split reported earlier; fifty-eight actions were logged in the past day, with Wightwalk and Crow's Nest each drawing sixteen and Shattered Advance twelve, the latest falling at this packet's cutoff. The Nevish Line has swung the other way, the Colonials recovering to six works against two Warden and none unclaimed, though it remains among the heaviest hourly tolls on the map with nine actions in two hours. Linn Mercy edged to seven Colonial, two Warden and two unclaimed, with Lathair still the hottest single position. Stonecradle and Marban Hollow have gone quiet after earlier stirrings; Mooring County remains entirely Warden, twelve works, its tempo fallen away. Callahan's Passage records no flips but the heaviest twenty-four-hour casualty totals. The map remains overwhelmingly Colonial, with Warden strength massed in the north and west.
